title: Storm Sorceress Over City
description: A female sorceress with long white hair and ornate golden armor stands on a stone platform in the foreground, holding a glowing blue and gold staff. Behind her, a massive swirling turquoise waterspout rises from a stormy sea, carrying sailing ships upward toward a futuristic city skyline under a dark, lightning-filled sky with orange fighter jets flying above.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with flowing white hair and ornate golden armor stands on stone steps holding a glowing magical staff, long colorful ribbons and energy swirling around her. A giant turquoise waterspout vortex rises from a stormy ocean filled with old sailing ships being pulled into the sky, with a futuristic city skyline visible in the background under dark purple storm clouds with lightning and orange fighter jets flying above, dramatic fantasy scene
